name: WhatsApp Call
description: Shows an active WhatsApp call in the notch: call icon and elapsed time with a live waveform — your voice in green, the other participant in orange — plus microphone, End call and camera controls. Detects calls in the WhatsApp desktop app and in web.whatsapp.com browser tabs.

settings.title: Refresh
settings.description: How often the plugin checks for an active WhatsApp call.

settings.title: WhatsApp Desktop App
settings.description: Detect calls opened in the WhatsApp macOS app.

settings.title: WhatsApp Web In Tabs
settings.description: Detect calls in web.whatsapp.com browser tabs via Apple Events.

settings.title: Fallback Without JavaScript
settings.description: Show the activity from the in-call URL when JavaScript from Apple Events is unavailable, with unknown mic and camera state.

settings.title: Diagnostic Activity
settings.description: Show a fake call so you can preview the interface without joining one.

settings.title: Live Waveform
settings.description: Your voice in green, the other participant in orange, animated while a call runs.
